reading: A cyclic translate family {x+k} is T1 iff the consecutive differences of x are pairwise distinct; then they exhaust Z_n minus 0 and x_{n-1}-x_0 equals their sum, which is 0 mod n for odd n (forcing a repeated symbol) and n/2 for even n. Orders 3,5,7 have no T1 translate family; orders 2,4,6 do. This exercises exactly the endpoint step of Theorem A, not the whole proof.
limits: Own stdlib enumeration over all bases with x0=0 for n<=7; not a census of T1(p) and no T2 or order-11 statement.
